changes: FUNC + PART now opens Kits' own Part Edit window: SAVE KIT, RELOAD KIT and RENAME KIT, in PART's place.
RENAME KIT renames the pattern's Kit; RELOAD KIT brings it back as saved.
Now offered together with Pattern Sample Locks: each has its own row in that window.
FUNC + PASTE + PART still copies the pasted pattern's Kit to the next empty one.
Needs Modwerk base 0.8 or newer, over USB.
Kits comes to Modwerk: 255 Kits per project, and each pattern plays its own. PART loads a Kit, FUNC+PART saves one.
Projects without Kits are read in the first time: each Part becomes a Kit and its patterns keep playing it.
Borrows about 2 MB of sample memory only while installed, and gives it back when removed. Needs Modwerk base 0.7.4 or newer, over USB.
Not offered together with Pattern Sample Locks: both use the Part menu. After a Sync, Kits starts working once you press Keep.
Known issue: SAVE KIT, pattern chains and a power cycle are not yet tested on a unit.
